notes.title: Echoes of the End review - unrelenting battles spoil a cohesive action-adventure
notes.content:
Choreographing the rapid-fire blows of combat in a game can be a delicate business. Think the 'tough but fair' ethos of Dark Souls that's encouraged masochists to slug it out within the game's decaying ruins, or the barely perceptible increase in reload time for Halo 3's sniper rifle from 0.5 to 0.7 seconds - a tweak that Bungie implemented to prevent the weapon from dominating matches. Such considerations enable developers to craft satisfyingly visceral fights without being too frustrating; to impart the adrenaline of combat without reducing wins to hollow victories.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Echoes of the End (PC) Review
notes.content:
I blindly went into Mykur Games’ Echoes of the End, and that was for the better. From preview reactions, some noted how this game and production could be compared to that of Sandfall Interactive’s Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Mykur Games also had around a 40+ team size, and invested a lot of their craft into a narrative-driven AA-title. After finishing Echoes of the End, I could say there were so many creative elements and eye-catching environments—in some ways better than Clair Obscur: Expedition 33.

Echoes of the End is a cinematic third-person action-adventure game. It blends a deeply personal, character-driven story with thrilling magic and sword-based combat, engaging traversal, and thought-provoking puzzles. Inspired by Iceland, this epic adventure offers a mature, rich, and immersive experience in a breathtaking and original fantasy world.

Step into the shoes of Ryn, a vestige wielding volatile yet powerful magic, as she battles to save her brother, Cor, from a... Read more

notes.title: Update - Patch and combat update coming on Thursday
notes.content: [p][b]Tomorrow marks a week[/b] since the launch of [i]Echoes of the End[/i], but that doesn’t mean we’ve been resting on our laurels! After last week's updates, the team has been hard at work reviewing more of your feedback on combat and other issues you've encountered since launch, and we’ll be rolling out two more updates this week in response.[/p][p]The first, coming [b][strike]tomorrow[/strike][/b] (please refer to the update at the bottom of the post), focuses on stability and polish, fixing several crashes, soft locks, and other technical issues players have reported, such as missing terrain on certain hardware. You can expect improvements to a few of our boss encounters as well, with Skuggi in particular receiving balance tweaks (as well as a fix to a rare bug causing players to not receive a skill point upon defeating him), and Zara’s shield gaining clearer visuals and sound effects to communicate its function to the player. Additional improvements include more forgiving dodge timing, larger subtitles, and some chapter-specific fixes to prevent unintended skips or progression blocks. [/p][p]Full patch notes will follow when the patch releases tomorrow, but the changes to dodge timing in particular are the first step in a more thorough [b]combat update[/b] arriving on Thursday, that we believe will go far to address some of the issues players have been reporting there.[/p][p]Alongside these updates, we're looking into other areas that matter to you guys (such as fixes to ultrawide cutscenes, HDR and DLSS framegen), and will keep you updated on each of these as we move forward.[/p][p]Thanks for all of your support so far, and we hope you continue to enjoy Ryn's story as we keep working to improve your experience with the game.[/p][p][b]UPDATE:[/b] We were unfortunately not able to test the patch for today (Tuesday) to a point where we were satisfied with pushing it out to the public. Instead of risking a patch that may introduce further issues, we are combining it with Thursday's larger combat update. We thank you for the understanding and support you've shown so far, and hope you will continue to enjoy your journeys through Aema as we continue to work to improve your experience with Echoes of the End.[/p]

notes.title: Update - A fix to shader-related stuttering
notes.content: [p][b]As we mentioned in our patch notes yesterday[/b], we've been hard at work implementing and testing a fix to the shader precompilation issues that have caused some players to experience hitches and stuttering during gameplay, especially in the game's earlier chapters. Today's update (which is now live!) should go far to address these issues, but we encourage you to let us know if you still encounter hitches during gameplay after updating. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all once again for all your support, and we hope you continue to enjoy your time in Aema![/p]

notes.title: Update - Patch tomorrow and performance fixes Friday
notes.content: [p][b]It’s been a busy couple of days[/b] here at the Myrkur Games studio, and we want to start by thanking you all for the incredible support you’ve shown the game! As we mentioned in our last post, we’ve been keeping a close eye on the performance issues some players have reported, particularly hitches and stutters in the PC build caused by shaders not being captured correctly for precompilation. [b]We have found the source of the problem, which should address stutter issues [/b]caused by shaders being compiled during play.[/p][p]Tomorrow we’ll be implementing and testing these changes, and we’re confident we can [b]deliver them to you on Friday[/b], just in time for a smooth weekend of gaming. In the meantime, you can expect another patch tomorrow addressing several other reported issues.[/p][p]Thank you again for joining us on this journey. We hope you continue to enjoy your time in Aema![/p]

notes.title: Regarding feedback on performance issues
notes.content: [p][b]The game has been live for around five hours now[/b], and as expected we're seeing user feedback pouring in! We're thrilled to see you all finally be able to enjoy Ryn's story, but unfortunately we are seeing that some of you are experiencing some performance issues, particularly in the game's earlier chapters. [/p][p]We want to assure you that we are actively looking into these reports and will be moving forward with patches to address this [b]rapidly[/b]. To help us with this, it would be extremely useful if you would report any performance hitches you experience here in the discussions for this news post, ideally including the following:[/p][p][b]Where in the game[/b] you experienced them.[/p][p][b]What graphic settings[/b] you are running the game on (including quality settings, resolution, DLSS or other).[/p][p][b]Your hardware specs[/b] (including CPU, GPU and RAM).[/p][p]Thank you all once more for your support on this adventure, and we hope we can quickly address whatever issues you're facing so you can get back to Aema as soon as possible![/p][p][/p][p][b]UPDATE[/b]: We have identified the source of the problem regarding hitches and stutters caused by shaders not being captured correctly for precompilation and are confident we have found a solution. Tomorrow we’ll be implementing and testing these changes, and we expect to [b]deliver them to you on Friday. [/b]Thank you for your feedback, and for your patience.[/p]

notes.title: New earth-splitting ARPG Echoes of the End blends God of War with Hellblade
notes.content:
It's an exciting time in the indie and double-A space right now. As players continue to turn their noses up at the MTX-filled liveservice behemoths and triple-A releases that betray their hefty price tags with uninspired gameplay, there is a collective yearning for 'the good ol' days' of gaming. The recent success of Expedition 33 speaks for itself, with Sandfall Interactive's JeRPG proving you don't need billion-dollar budgets and hundreds of developers to craft something exceptional. Myrkur Games is hoping to recreate the magic with Echoes of the End, a new ARPG that will scratch your God of War itch, set in an world inspired by the Icelandic studio's homeland.

notes.title: Echoes of the End is now available!
notes.content:
[p][b]This is it! [/b]After years of hard work, [i]Echoes of the End[/i] is now available to the public! It’s been a journey beyond compare, and we couldn’t be happier with where we are today. But the work doesn’t stop yet! There will be a Day 1 patch dropping in just a few hours, and in the coming days, weeks and months we’ll be continuing to update and fix any issues you guys come across as you play (though hopefully they will be minimal!)
[/p][p]We won’t take up any more of your time reading this. The game is out, go play it! But we’ll leave you with a link to our launch trailer, that we hope gets you in the mood to go kick some ass.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="eDusaQf-zGU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]From the bottom of our hearts here at Myrkur Games, thank you for coming on this journey alongside us. Make sure you follow this community hub for future updates and patch notes, and as ever, we look forward to seeing you in Aema.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: The journey begins tomorrow!
notes.content:
[p][b]Tomorrow’s the day![/b] [i]Echoes of the End[/i] is officially releasing, and after the years we’ve spent pouring our hearts into this project, we couldn’t be more excited to share it with all of you.[/p][p]It’s been a long journey for our small team here at Myrkur Games, and it’s hard to express just how grateful we are for the support you guys have shown us along the way. From watching players try out our earliest prototypes and demos at places like GDC and Gamescom way back in 2018 and 2019, to now, seeing you all engage with our content and trailers as we’re finally on the verge of releasing a game that we hope feels personal, meaningful, and most importantly of all, fun.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650707/ca6180dfc2e75dd43de8d0a1993459060e76a6d0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]If this is the first you’re hearing of it[/b], [i]Echoes of the End[/i] is an action-adventure game that follows the journey of Ryn, a ranger of Noi Syrouve, on a quest to rescue her brother and stop a brewing invasion. You’ll find yourself navigating a landscape full of beauty and danger, facing powerful enemies in deadly combat that emphasizes melee combos and devastating magic, and building relationships with characters who are just as complex as the world they inhabit.[/p][p]We can’t wait for you to experience what we’ve been working on for so long. Thanks for being part of this journey with us, and we hope you enjoy what’s coming tomorrow.[/p][p]We'll see you in Aema.[/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: Dev Vlog - Designing a cinematic combat system
notes.content: [p][b]Combat is the beating heart of action-adventure games. [/b]For many players, it's going to be the largest determining factor in whether or not they enjoy a game they're playing, and for others, it's the only reason they're playing the game in the first place. But what defines a good combat system? [/p][p]In this week's dev vlog, we dive headlong into that question, as we talk about the two contradictory goals of combat in [i]Echoes of the End[/i], and wonder: how do you make the player feel powerful, while simultaneously making them feel challenged?[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="hgfzCkApTcI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]Echoes of the End[/i] launches August 12th. Wishlist the game and follow this community hub for all the latest updates as we get closer to release![/p]

notes.title: Dev Vlogs - How photogrammetry & motion capture changed the AA landscape
notes.content:
[p][b]If the last 8 years[/b] in the gaming industry have taught us here at Myrkur Games anything, it's that game development is now more accessible than ever. The landscape is changing rapidly, and technological advancements in fields like motion capture and photogrammetry have made incredible things possible for small studios like ours. [/p][p]If you're curious to see how we used these advancements in our production of [i]Echoes of the End[/i], or if you want to see how you might be able to do the same to make that game you've been thinking about, here are two dev vlogs we made recently, one on each subject. Go take a look! [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="wYeHQjYI9x4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][previewyoutube="LCmHr-EfODQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[i]Echoes of the End[/i] releases this summer, so make sure to wishlist the game and follow this community hub for more behind-the-scenes looks and updates![/p]

notes.content:
[p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe3pOTXOflsGZ8cZIRxLrkfX_qxlQl3GnntCskLvrTqT-JdjV41pynBVL4-KrqIZBVgFDo2agbTJWW18UFAhyyVSaNAAaZ1SdGd3CyY5a1nyfzSqQfcviCDVKdEeBNpr1JS4QWtEQ?key=HSRBtkRbjt44V6kmxkbnUQ"][/img][/p][h3][i]“The world ended long ago. We’re only living in its echoes.”[/i][/h3][p][/p][p]We here at Myrkur Games are incredibly excited to finally announce that our debut title, [i]Echoes of the End[/i], will be coming to PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S this summer. If you missed it, you can watch the announcement trailer here: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/M6vsxYyQZnA"][/dynamiclink].[/p][p] [img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeUr_FyZj-GmQdkGPgtPNP0fSJl8Zn6C2ZkOXMFY-orIcZC7zwzFTRQ20iIdAvul8Ov68pHLUE5wfyPvzhd3zeEdJdF41GGK8ONHEYgShHKMWJGRO3GdyVmbfov7HeutQe6KIiQWA?key=HSRBtkRbjt44V6kmxkbnUQ"][/img][/p][p]Set in the original fantasy world of Aema, [i]Echoes of the End[/i] is a cinematic third-person action-adventure game that blends fast-paced combat, puzzle-solving, and exploration with a grounded, character-focused narrative. Inspired by the dramatic landscapes of Iceland, Aema is a harsh, ancient land, scarred by the horrors of ages gone by.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcqayxhxduuo0vuCoLvJWMRMZ9yHbMIMyzrnTU_neAAwQHvOCQCRS3KcP9JImCq4IiNkqV_4G0eePlO9EvYl9lqER5ugyML3ve-9T-pU0ace_S4baEPh2Oid9nOV0BRIhr89vzATQ?key=HSRBtkRbjt44V6kmxkbnUQ"][/img]You’ll play as Ryn, a ranger and vestige; one born with an affinity for ancient magic that most wish had stayed buried with the past. When her younger brother is taken captive by a totalitarian empire, she’s forced to embrace the part of herself she’s worked all her life to suppress, and set out on a journey across a broken world to bring him home.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXelb1YQch2w99ZkSN5uIGpyMdNeCZJiGoZbai8juL9CVGpzkq3X7sUQTGC5gs_9bTiYaS9n-xPEKbRWP97MgDJw9VTAPaTuJnheH1YRrdufzG7mDaZdErNh_9WD1FL4RMcgDDCa7Q?key=HSRBtkRbjt44V6kmxkbnUQ"][/img][/p][p]But she won’t face it alone. At her side is Abram Finlay, a scholar and explorer whose depth of knowledge and quiet humor offer a much-needed counterbalance to the world’s growing darkness. What begins as a reluctant partnership slowly becomes something deeper, forged through trust, shared loss, and a common purpose.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650707/d78ec01abdbbe972364cc0169c749484fe544bac.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Echoes of the End[/i] is the first title from us here at Myrkur Games, a small studio based in Reykjavík, Iceland. We’ve spent the past few years building this world from the ground up, working to bring something original and meaningful to life.[/p][p]We couldn’t be more excited to finally share this journey with you. There’s still more to come, and we’ll be sharing new details over the coming weeks. Until then, thank you for being here. We can’t wait to show you what’s next.[/p][p]Discover more and wishlist:[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2821610/Echoes_of_the_End/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Follow us on:[/p][p]Facebook: [url="https://www.facebook.com/myrkurgames/"]https://www.facebook.com/myrkurgames/[/url][/p][p]Instagram: [url="https://www.instagram.com/myrkurgames/?hl=en"]https://www.instagram.com/myrkurgames/?hl=en[/url][/p][p]YouTube: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/c/MyrkurGames"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]TikTok: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@myrkurgames"]https://www.tiktok.com/@myrkurgames[/url] [/p][p]
